Container.Name: home-work-hours-tracker
Container.Overview: A self-hosted diary of hours worked from home. Days auto-fill from a weekly or fortnightly schedule, and it exports an accountant-ready spreadsheet for the ATO fixed-rate claim. Single-user, no auth — the home network is the trust boundary. Installs as a PWA.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port the app listens on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database and any generated files. Back this up.

Config.Description: Group ID that should own files in /data.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone used to decide the local date. Unraid sets this automatically; override for non-Unraid hosts.
